summary: Resolve org and project once and inject them into every generated endpoint command.
reason: Every Rightbrain path is /org/{org_id}/project/{project_id}/..., so all ~290 generated commands took two UUIDs positionally. Injection is additive: a fully-specified invocation passes through untouched. Adds scope show|use|clear.
validated_outcome: Verified across five cases: saved config, env vars, flags, explicit positionals, and an extra trailing positional.
